summary: Sigma Lithium Corp filed a Form 6-K on July 15, 2026, reporting voting results from its annual and special meeting of shareholders held June 30, 2026. The report covers routine matters: fixing the board at five directors, election of five nominees (Ana Cristina Cabral, Marcelo Paiva, Junaid Jafar, Alexandre Rodrigues Cabral, and Kátia Abreu) with overwhelming support (97-99%+ votes for), and appointment of Grant Thornton Auditores Independentes as auditors. There is no special situation, as this is a standard periodic disclosure of shareholder meeting results under Canadian continuous disclosure rules (NI 51-102) filed as a foreign private issuer report. No deal, activist campaign, or corporate action is present.
